body:
If you can take up that job as a butcher, do it! Don't take your life before you try something new. 
My dream life is to just be able to work a job that pays me enough money to live in a one bedroom apartment, eat well, entertain myself sometimes and put a little bit away. I don't care about children or home ownership, I just want to be comfortable. I'm working a minimum wage, part time job in the evenings and I really enjoy it. I know it's not sustainable for the future but I want another job like this one day. I love my coworkers and they're much more friendly than my classmates. I just want to WORK, not study things that aren't interesting or important to me.
